combo_label: Halloween × The Olympics × The Wizard of Oz

entries.clue: Mildly and enjoyably eerie, the mood the decorations aim for
American swimmer who left Beijing in 2008 with eight golds
Leathery night fliers, cut from black card and taped up in windows
Gingham-frocked girl swept off the plains into a land of talking beasts
Tea left standing to strengthen, or a dark mixture set simmering
Boxers' contest in the ring, settled on points or by a stoppage
Hollow tube a sprinter must pass on inside the changeover zone
Plucky little cairn terrier who leaps out of the basket and runs for home
Grand academic title the roadside showman named Marvel awards to himself
Handheld brand lit from the sun at Olympia and relayed to the host city
Deep red gem lending its name to the film's famous pair of magic slippers
Long mournful cry a wolf sends up into the night
Baum's word for the whirling column of wind that tears a house from the prairie
